environment.description: ECS Fargate task running in a private subnet with an IAM task role (arn:aws:iam::111122223333:role/task-executor-role) that has dynamodb:PutItem, dynamodb:GetItem, dynamodb:Query on the task table with no condition keys. The service is exposed via an internal ALB with no request filtering. Container runs as root with default seccomp profile (unconfined). The gob decoder accepts arbitrary registered types including exec.Cmd.

config.network: internal ALB, no WAF, no request inspection
config.container: root user, unconfined seccomp, CAP_SYS_ADMIN retained
